description:
## 1.0.0 (2026-11-17)

### ✨ New Features

* Graff patches for Telegraph Plus 13.0.2.0 ([d3fddd3](https://github.com/Finn013/graff-patches/commit/d3fddd38466cb7d7219f5b4840231659fc4ee10e))

patches.name: Block Graph servers
patches.description: Points the Graph Messenger remote config (ads ids, forced update version, update nag, recommended chats) and the Graph AI API to 127.0.0.1, so the app never contacts graphmessenger.com.

patches.name: Change package name
patches.description: Changes the package to ir.finni.graff (configurable) so Graff installs next to the original Telegraph Plus. Rewrites the manifest (providers, permissions) and package strings in code. A renamed app is a separate app: it has its own login and data.

options.description: New package name. Must differ from every other installed app.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Stops AppMetrica (Yandex) from sending data right after it is activated, turns off Firebase Analytics collection and removes the AppMetrica preload provider.

patches.name: Disable signature check
patches.description: Required. Disables p2021's self signature check ("Your Telegraph Messenger is modified") and the hidden package name check that closes the app, so the re-signed app starts.

patches.name: Graff branding
patches.description: Renames the app (default "Graff") and replaces the default launcher icon with the Graff adaptive icon.

options.description: Name shown under the launcher icon.

patches.name: Raccoon intro
patches.description: Replaces the welcome screen logo textures: a raccoon peeks over the Telegram sphere, signed "by Nott".

patches.name: Remove P2021 dialogs
patches.description: Removes the "P2021_MODS - Subscribe / JOIN US" channel dialogs (on app start and in the mod settings).

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Stops the ad SDKs (AppLovin MAX, InMobi, AdMob mediation) from initialising, removes their auto-start providers and the advertising ID / Ad Services permissions.

patches.name: Remove forced update
patches.description: Removes the "this version is no longer supported" dialog that blocks the app when the remote config marks the version as outdated.
